prompt.text: Several food chains in a forest overlap, and fungi break down dead leaves. Which explanation is best?

options.label: The overlapping chains form a food web, and decomposers help recycle nutrients.
The overlap means there is no food web, and fungi are producers.
Decomposers stop nutrients from returning to the environment.
Every organism in the food web must eat exactly one food.

feedback.correct: Correct. A food web links feeding paths, while decomposers recycle material.
